title: A Pinch of SFT, A Dash of RL: When Reinforcement Learning Helps Long-Horizon Advertising Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.22194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise analytics agents solve long-horizon tool-use problems over distributed business data, requiring retrieval, reasoning, API calls, code execution, and adaptation to intermediate observations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) calibrates tool syntax and teacher-supported behavior, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) can explore reward-supported behaviors beyond demonstrations; applied uniformly, however, RL can perturb already-calibrated skills. We study how to balance SFT and RL under production-mirroring beta APIs. We observe that, in our controlled experiment, checkpoint trajectories retrospectively separated into three regimes: Imitation, where SFT captured reliable teacher behavior; Lift, where both stages helped; and Discovery, where useful reward-observable behavior lay outside reliable teacher support. We leverage this prospectively, using teacher support and reward-observable headroom to route features to SFT only, SFT then R

translated_title: 一点SFT，一撮RL：强化学习何时能助力长时程广告智能体
translated_abstract: 企业分析智能体需要解决基于分布式业务数据的长时程工具使用问题，涉及检索、推理、API调用、代码执行以及对中间观察结果的适应。监督微调（SFT）可以校准工具语法和教师支持的行为，而强化学习（RL）能够探索演示之外的有奖励支持的行为；然而，如果统一应用，RL可能会扰动已经校准好的技能。我们研究如何在镜像生产环境的beta API下平衡SFT和RL。我们观察到，在受控实验中，检查点轨迹回顾性地分为三种状态：模仿，即SFT捕获了可靠的教师行为；提升，即两个阶段都有帮助；发现，即有用的奖励可观察行为位于可靠的教师支持范围之外。我们前瞻性地利用这一发现，使用教师支持和奖励可观察的提升空间将特征路由到仅SFT、先SFT后RL等不同训练路径。
tldr: 该论文通过将特征按“模仿、提升、发现”三种状态，依据教师支持程度和奖励可观察空间路由到仅SFT或先SFT后RL的训练路径，解决了如何在不破坏已校准技能的前提下让强化学习有效提升长时程广告分析智能体表现的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes routing features to SFT-only or SFT-then-RL training paths based on teacher support and reward-observable headroom across three regimes (Imitation, Lift, Discovery), enabling reinforcement learning to improve long-horizon advertising agents without perturbing already-calibrated skills.
